tools.name: smoove_get_contact_fields
tools.description: List the contact field definitions of the account, system and custom, with their keys and types. Call this first to learn the field keys (e.g. firstName, i1) that other tools accept. Smoove API: GET /v1/Account/ContactFields.

tools.name: smoove_list_contacts
tools.description: List active (not deleted) contacts with the chosen fields, paged and sorted. Use smoove_get_contact for one contact. Smoove API: GET /v1/Contacts.

tools.name: smoove_get_contact
tools.description: Get one contact by its id, email, cell phone or external id. Smoove API: GET /v1/Contacts/{id}.

tools.name: smoove_contact_exists
tools.description: Check whether a contact exists in the account. Returns true or false. Smoove API: GET /v1/Contacts/{id}/Exists.

tools.name: smoove_list_unsubscribed_contacts
tools.description: List contacts who unsubscribed, with the unsubscribe time and reason. Use it to check opt-outs before a send. Smoove API: GET /v1/Contacts_Unsubscribers.

tools.name: smoove_list_lists
tools.description: List the contact lists of the account, with names and optional contact counts. Smoove API: GET /v1/Lists.

tools.name: smoove_list_contacts_in_list
tools.description: List the contacts that belong to one list, with the chosen fields. Smoove API: GET /v1/Lists/{id}/Contacts.

tools.name: smoove_list_campaign_templates
tools.description: List the custom email campaign templates of the account. Smoove API: GET /v1/Campaigns_Templates.

tools.name: smoove_get_campaign_statistics
tools.description: Get the aggregated report of one email campaign: sent, bounced, opened, clicked and unsubscribed counts. Smoove API: GET /v1/Campaigns/{id}/Statistics.

tools.name: smoove_list_landing_pages
tools.description: List the active landing pages and sign-up forms of the account. Smoove API: GET /v1/LandingPages.

tools.name: smoove_upsert_contact
tools.description: Create a contact, or update it when one matches the email, externalId or cellPhone. Only set canReceiveEmails to true when the person opted in. Smoove API: POST /v1/Contacts?updateIfExists=true.

tools.name: smoove_unsubscribe_contact
tools.description: Unsubscribe a contact from email and campaigns, with an optional reason. The contact stops receiving messages. Smoove API: POST /v1/Contacts/{id}/Unsubscribe.

tools.name: smoove_create_list
tools.description: Create a new contact list in the account. Smoove API: POST /v1/Lists.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: smoove_get_contact, smoove_list_campaign_templates, smoove_get_campaign_statistics, smoove_create_list · Private data: smoove_get_contact_fields, smoove_list_contacts, smoove_get_contact, smoove_contact_exists, smoove_list_unsubscribed_contacts, smoove_list_lists, smoove_list_contacts_in_list, smoove_upsert_contact, smoove_unsubscribe_contact, smoove_create_list · Public sink: smoove_get_contact, smoove_list_unsubscribed_contacts, smoove_list_campaign_templates, smoove_get_campaign_statistics, smoove_upsert_contact, smoove_unsubscribe_contact, smoove_create_list.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: smoove_get_contact, smoove_list_campaign_templates, smoove_get_campaign_statistics, smoove_create_list · Private data: smoove_get_contact_fields, smoove_list_contacts, smoove_get_contact, smoove_contact_exists, smoove_list_unsubscribed_contacts, smoove_list_lists, smoove_list_contacts_in_list, smoove_upsert_contact, smoove_unsubscribe_contact, smoove_create_list · Public sink: smoove_get_contact, smoove_list_unsubscribed_contacts, smoove_list_campaign_templates, smoove_get_campaign_statistics, smoove_upsert_contact, smoove_unsubscribe_contact, smoove_create_list

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
